# Sakhr Software

> Pioneer in advanced Arabic language technology and Natural Language Processing (NLP) solutions, with 28+ years of R&D serving governments and enterprises worldwide.

Sakhr Software develops Arabic NLP technologies including Machine Translation, Optical Character Recognition (OCR), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Speech Recognition, search, and morphological analysis. Flagship products include Sahehly and ArabDox.
